sentences.text: 21.07.2023 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners for quashing the criminal proceeding against them in G.R. Case No.2956 of 2022 in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Talcher which arises out of Kaniha P.S. Case No.345 of 2022.

2. Ms.S.Patnaik, learned Addl. Government Advocate has produced the case diary in which the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and the statement of her friend,
Sagarika Behera under Section 161 Cr.P.C, are available.
3. The prosecution allegation in brief is that the main accused- Saroj Kumar Pradhan had forcibly taken the victim with the help of the present petitioners from her village.
He then shifted her to different places and beat and threatened her and had sexual intercourse with her //2// against her will.
Allegation of sexual assault has not been made by the victim against the present petitioners.
4. Mr.Rakesh Behera, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the allegation against the petitioners does not make out a case under Sections 376 (2) (n)/ 366 of IPC against them.
Preliminary charge sheet has been submitted against the main accused, Saroj Kumar Pradhan.

But as the main accused against whom allegation under Sections 376 (2) (n)/366 and 506 IPC had been made has been released on bail pursuant to order dated 24.03.2023 passed in BLAPL No.408 of Bapi @ Purusottam Behera vs State Of Odisha .....

sentences.text:

1 2023 by this Court and the petitioners stand on a better footing than him, they do not want to press this CRLMC and want to surrender before the learned Court below and move an application for bail.
He prays that a direction may be issued for disposal of the bail application on the same day.

5. Perusal of the case diary reveals that preliminary charge sheet dated 14.02.2023 under Sections 365/366/376 (2) (n)/343/506/34 of IPC has been filed against the co-accused Saroj Kumar Pradhan who was in custody and the case has been kept open for further investigation.
Perusal of the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. reveals that allegation under Section 376 (2) (n) has been made against main accused, Saroj Kumar Pradhan only.

Considering the above submissions, the CRLMC is disposed of directing that if the petitioners surrender before the learned S.D.J.M., Talcher on or before 11.08.2023 in G.R. Case No.2956 of 2022 and file an application for bail, the same shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in accordance with law to enable the petitioners to Bichi move the higher court on the same day, in case of necessity.
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Savitri Ratho) Judge Signed by: BICHITRANANDA SAHOO
